justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/pool/TypePool.java. FieldTokenList is a small protected inner adapter at lines 3528-3542 with only two methods, get(int) and size(), both delegating directly to the backing fieldTokens list to produce FieldDescription instances. The surrounding code shows it is one of several parallel helper lists (FieldTokenList/MethodTokenList/RecordComponentTokenList) used by LazyTypeDescription, not a multifaceted class with many responsibilities, so there is no evidence of insufficient modularization.
